titulo: The whole situation in one line
caption:
She walked in ten minutes late. Someone gave her the whole situation in one line, and she sat down already in it.

A one-line recap lets a latecomer join the thread instead of guessing at it.

For whoever catches the latecomer up.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.
